independent_reproduction: A separately waited venv child reported an inside-Python PID different from the parent-observed Popen PID.
limitations: The original result did not record the inside-owner PID/birth and cannot validate the handle identity.
The fake CPU model is not a production GPU owner and the separate full CPU suite overlapped.
Do not use this observation as a resource envelope or admission bound.
reason: The owner process handle came from the Windows venv redirector, not the Python interpreter executing the CPU owner; owner and combined working-set values are invalid.
